login.lede: Log in to control your home.
login.resetNote: Enter your email address. We’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
login.resetSent: If there is an account for {email}, you’ll get an email with a link to choose a new password. Have a look in your junk mail too.
login.wrongCombination: This email address and password don’t match. Check them and try again.

account.passwordTooShort: Choose a password of at least {min} characters
account.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords aren’t the same
account.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again
account.offline: No connection to Sandhovius. Check your internet and try again
account.emailTaken: There is already an account with this email address
account.somethingWrong: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment

verify.sent: We’ve sent an email to {email}. Open the link in it to confirm your address. Have a look in your junk mail too.
verify.sendFailed: Your account has been created, but the confirmation email to {email} wasn’t sent. Send it again below.
verify.resent: The email has been sent again.

confirm.busy: There were too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again; your link still works.
confirm.offline: Sandhovius can’t be reached right now. Check your internet connection and try again; your link still works.
confirm.invalidNote: The link has expired or has already been used. Log in and ask for a new confirmation email.

reset.title: Choose a new password.
reset.invalidNote: The link has expired or has already been used. Choose “Forgot your password?” on the login screen for a new one.
reset.failed: The password couldn’t be changed. Try again in a moment

settings.languageHint: For the app and for the emails you get from Sandhovius.
settings.languageFailed: The language couldn’t be changed. Try again in a moment.

attention.many: {count, plural, one {# device needs} other {# devices need}} attention
attention.title: Needs attention

home.noHouse: There’s no home linked to your account yet. As soon as your Sandhovius box is linked to your account, your home will appear here.

firstDevice.title: Add your first device
firstDevice.text: A light, plug, sensor or thermostat. It appears on Home straight away, so you can control it with one tap.

welcome.title: Your everyday lights go here
welcome.text: Press and hold a light or plug and choose “Show on Home”. Then you can control it with one tap, as soon as you open the app.

weather.title: Weather
weather.stale: Not updated since {time}. Does your Sandhovius box have internet?

failed.offline: {what} didn’t work. Sandhovius can’t be reached right now; check your internet connection and try again.
failed.signedOut: {what} didn’t work. You’ve been logged out; log in again.
failed.forbidden: {what} didn’t work. Your account isn’t allowed to change this.
failed.notFound: {what} didn’t work. It no longer exists; refresh the page.
failed.tooMany: {what} didn’t work. Too many attempts; wait a moment and try again.
failed.invalid: {what} didn’t work. Check what you filled in.
failed.other: {what} didn’t work. Try again in a moment.

household.invitedAs: Invited as {role, select, admin {an admin} other {a member}}, {expires}

invitation.label: Invitation to {house}
invitation.expiredText: {who} invited you to {house}. Ask for a new invitation.
invitation.title: {who} invites you to {house}
invitation.meta: As {role, select, admin {an admin} other {a member}}, {expires}.

connection.lost: No connection to Sandhovius. You’re seeing the last known state of your devices. We’ll keep trying.
connection.noBox: No box is linked to this home. Until a box is linked, you’ll see the last known state of your devices.
connection.boxSilent: Your Sandhovius box isn’t responding. Check that the box has power and internet. Until it responds, you’ll see the last known state.
connection.boxSilentSince: Your Sandhovius box hasn’t responded since {since}. Check that the box has power and internet. Until it responds, you’ll see the last known state.

toast.boxUnreachable: Your Sandhovius box can’t be reached right now. Try again once it responds.
toast.sessionExpired: You’ve been logged out because your session expired. Log in again to continue.
toast.lostAccess: You no longer have access to {names}.
toast.couldNotAdjust: {name} couldn’t make that change. Try again.
toast.allOff: {count, plural, one {{name} is turning off} other {# devices are turning off}}
toast.roomOn: {count, plural, one {{name} is turning on} other {# devices in {room} are turning on}}
toast.roomOff: {count, plural, one {{name} is turning off} other {# devices in {room} are turning off}}
toast.gaveUp: {name} didn’t respond. You’re seeing the last known state again.
toast.failed: {name} didn’t respond. Check that the device has power and try again.
toast.sceneIncomplete: “{name}” didn’t fully work. Check Needs attention to see whether all your devices can be reached.

rooms.empty: No devices in this room yet. Add one with “Add”, or move a device here from its details.

deviceSheet.name: Name
deviceSheet.confirmDelete: Delete “{name}” from Sandhovius? The device disappears from the app; you can add it again later.
deviceSheet.offlineNote: Offline; this is the last known state.
